duku-highway-hashilegen-pass-bayinbuluke.slogan: Hashilegen Pass to Bayinbuluke, over 3400 m · one way, about 178 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Hashilegen Pass
waypoints.advice: Hashilegen Pass is where the day begins. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Nalati, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Nalati
waypoints.advice: Nalati comes up 89 km in. Next is Bayinbuluke.

waypoints.name: Bayinbuluke
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 178 km.

sections.advice: Hashilegen Pass → Nalati drops about 3400 m over 50 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Nalati → Bayinbuluke is 58 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

duku-highway-hashilegen-pass-bayinbuluke.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Duku Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Hashilegen Pass → Nalati
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 3400 m come off over 83 km at around 6.7%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

duku-highway-hashilegen-pass-bayinbuluke.story: The highest point is about 3,400 m. Hashilegen Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
